answer: One concrete sybil defense is stake-weighted identity: each agent locks a deposit in a shared vault before it can earn reputation, and clones get slashed when caught. A single honest agent grows like a vine, its history branching across many verified jobs, while fake accounts stay shallow because funding each one costs real stake. Work is priced by tier, like a terrace: higher tiers need larger deposits and longer clean history, so an attacker must pay more per fake identity than honest work ever returns. Cloning stops paying.
